Our tools are free & Safe (case teachable machine)
      GDPR compliant: “in terms of children’s rights, the tool supports the use of
      personal data while ensuring privacy and compliance with GDPR”
      WCAG 2.1AA: “the UX design is workflow-based, with minimal in-built
      instructional scaffolds, addressing accessibility and usability standards”
      HTML5: “The tool design aims at resilience and adaptability to various hardware
      and network/offline environments”
      MIT License: “permissive software lisence” (free to use and modify)
      Multilingual: EN, FI, SE, DE, RU, UA, BR, TR, IT, JP, KR.. (easy to localise)
